notes: Surface observations uniformly sampled in [-12, 12] km with seed 4401; depth 6 km, dip 50 degrees, bounds [-3, 3, -2, 2] km, slip [1, 0.6, 0.2] m. Times include harness conversion and Metal process startup, I/O and compilation. Memory is MiB. Metal's child ru_maxrss is a cumulative high-water mark, so its delta can be zero even when the child uses memory and excludes GPU allocations. MLX process RSS is a cumulative high-water mark. Relative differences use the maximum absolute reference value separately for each output. Medium comparison uses all observations.
